$comment: Source context: bootstrap/src/agent_workflows.rs reads note and tools separately. The note explains workflow authorization; the tools define deferred skill discovery and reads. This comment is author metadata and is not part of either returned value.
note: Read a skill before its workflow. Availability and authorization come from the serving and its gates, not from reading a skill.

tools.name: list_jazyk_skills
tools.description: List built-in deferred Jazyk workflow skills, their triggers, required capabilities, and source paths. Read-only. No graph or setId needed.

tools.name: read_jazyk_skill
tools.description: Read the exact instructions of one built-in Jazyk workflow skill before using it. A skill grants no new tool, permission, or cost approval. No graph or setId needed.
